card.name: Liver terms: hepatic after hep
card.fires_on: The ending "atic" of "hepatic" right after "hep", and sometimes the start of "Hep" in hepatotoxicity, in liver-injury warnings.

modes.label: hepatic after hep
modes.description: The piece "atic" completing "hepatic" before a liver complication such as veno-occlusive disease, toxicity or dysfunction.

modes.label: Other liver-injury wording
modes.description: Linking or opening pieces in liver injury phrases, such as "of" after patterns or "Hep" at the start of hepatotoxicity.
